title: fields: a file the reader may not open arrives as `{ id, metadataRefused: true }` (objectstack#22593) and still shows a generic file chip — show a restricted state (the objectui half, after #12030)
body:
Filing gate **④ a coordination node: the objectui half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#22593** (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#22620 → `02d9f69e5a`, on the 18 `next` line). It was filed by objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post #5560, `session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z`) under the seat's judgment Q7 in record `6148150305` on #12030.
- **Reader (who acts):** the objectui `domain:ui` lane, once objectui#12030 lands. Until then `@object-ui/*` resolves spec 17, which has no marker.
- **Dedupe:** MCP `search_issues` in objectui, closed included, for `file field metadataRefused restricted state FileValueView sys_file read refused file chip`: 0 hits.
- ⛔ Not a claim. For triage to grade.

## What the platform now sends

When the caller may read a record but is refused `sys_file` read, a file field's expanded read form is `{ id, metadataRefused: true }`. It used to be the bare id, which the console could not tell from "no file".
- `@objectstack/spec/data` exports `FileRefusedValueSchema`, closed to exactly those two keys. The seat read it in the published `18.0.0-next.0` tarball (`src/data/field-value.zod.ts`).
- The stored form is unchanged.
- objectstack-ai/objectstack#22637 (ruling B on objectstack-ai/objectstack#22624) will next hydrate a file the record itself owns, even for such a reader. After that, the marker remains only for ids the record does not own.

## What objectui does with it today

`readFileValue` (`packages/fields/src/widgets/file-value.ts`) takes the marker through its object arm. It keeps the id, builds the URL from it, falls back to the name `'File'`, and sets no `mimeType`. `metadataRefused` is not carried onto `FileValueView`. So the console shows a generic file chip, never `EmptyValue`, and the refusal never reaches the screen. The engine seat's consumer note is comment `6095969443` on #12030.

## Ask

The file renderers show a distinct restricted state for `metadataRefused: true`: the `FileField` read-only list, `FileCell`, `ImageField`, `AvatarField` and the grid cell.
- No thumbnail is attempted, because no MIME type is known.
- The open/download affordance stays on the id-derived endpoint. That door decides on its own and may answer `403 FILE_DOWNLOAD_DENIED`.
- The editable widget still submits only the bare id (`fileIdOf` reads `id`), never the marker object.
- Pins on a real render: the marker shows the restricted state in each renderer, and a normal file value is unchanged.

## Restart when

objectui#12030 has merged, so objectui resolves `@objectstack/spec` 18 (`18.0.0-next.0` carries `FileRefusedValueSchema`).
